params.name: specialty
params.description: The practitioner has this specialty at an organization (Select PractitionerRoles associated with the specified specialty)

params.name: role
params.description: The practitioner can perform this role at for the organization (Select PractitionerRoles with the specified role)

params.name: location
params.description: One of the locations at which this practitioner provides care (Select PractitionerRoles available at the specified location)

params.name: organization
params.description: The identity of the organization the practitioner represents / acts on behalf of (Select PractitionerRoles available at the specified organization)

params.name: endpoint
params.description: Technical endpoints providing access to services operated for the practitioner with this role (Select PractitionerRoles with the specified endpoint)

params.name: service
params.description: The healthcare service that this worker provides for this role's Organization/Location(s) (Select PractitionerRoles providing the specified service)

params.name: practitioner
params.description: Practitioner that is able to provide the defined services for the organization (Select roles filled by the specified practitioner)

params.name: network
params.description: Select roles where the practitioner is a member of the specified health insurance provider network

params.name: _profile
params.description: Select resources based on a given HL7 profile.

params.name: _id
params.description: Select resource based on the logical `id`.

params.name: _lastUpdated
params.description:
Select resources based on the last time they were changed.

- Only date is supported in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.
- Prefixes supported are `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `lt`, `ge` and `le`. Refer to their definitions at http://hl7.org/fhir/search.html#prefix.

eg: `_lastUpdated=eq2021-01-14`

params.name: id
params.description: Fetch a resource using its logical `id`.
